ops.body: Round-8 DECISION verdict on 13d90e5f: BLOCK — two HIGH cancellation races, both via EXECUTED reproductions (the verifier also wrote its own anyio repro confirming the common case works; the races are narrower interleavings its test didn't cover). Race 1: outer cancel + own wall deadline simultaneously pending → U1's cancel_called guard defers to the wall branch, but anyio doesn't swallow the FOREIGN cancellation at move_on_after so the wall branch never runs → cleanup=False/after_inner=False/wall=False, zero accounting trace. Race 2: cancellation during the except-Exception handler's own recover_cost await → Python never re-matches against sibling except clauses → zero trace (journal/events/latch all absent at run() level). ROOT CAUSE: cleanup lives in exception-clause matching. A3.10 (round 9) = structural fix: unconditional SHIELDED try/finally accounting epilogue with a recorded-flag (exactly-once: already-recorded no-op / known-cost flush / unknown recover-or-latch), wall + classification semantics preserved as fast paths; both reproduced races become required tests + a no-double-record test. POST-RELEASE BACKLOG (triaged non-blocking under the pre-declared criterion): crafted anyio-marker-string double-record (exotic); second-SIGINT/KeyboardInterrupt shield piercing (forceful repeated interruption); valid-kind-missing-cost final sidecar row (writer always validates); U2's misleading label when the cc-notes mirror fails after a successful journal write (fail-safe, label-only); docstring rider folded into A3.10. U1/U2/U3 confirmed closed for round 7's findings; 6/7 new tests genuinely pin behavior.
